'''Mrs. Cannison''' was the [[Marriage/Legends|wife]] of [[Cannison (Minister)|Cannison]] and she accompanied her husband aboard the [[Yacht/Legends|yacht]] ''[[Twilight's Kiss]]'' in the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]] when he traveled there with [[Sargo VenHalgon]] for a vacation. VenHalgon had the ''Kiss'' land on [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]] and went off hunting with her husband. After the men failed to return, Mrs. Cannison went off to search for them, along with [[VenHalgon|Lady VenHalgon]] and [[Worrita (Mrs)|Mrs. Worrita]]. They themselves were eventually rescued by the native [[Tarasin]], who helped to reunite them with their husbands.
